pricing_rules_valid_window.name: pricing_rules_valid_window
pricing_rules_valid_window.value: "pricing_rules"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_from" <= "pricing_rules"."valid_to"

rental_agreements_checkin_complete.name: rental_agreements_checkin_complete
rental_agreements_checkin_complete.value: ("rental_agreements"."checked_in_at" IS NULL) = ("rental_agreements"."return_mileage_km" IS NULL) AND ("rental_agreements"."checked_in_at" IS NULL) = ("rental_agreements"."return_fuel_pct" IS NULL)

reservations_amounts_nonneg.name: reservations_amounts_nonneg
reservations_amounts_nonneg.value: "reservations"."daily_rate_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."rental_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."extras_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."one_way_fee_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."vat_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."deposit_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."cancellation_fee_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."late_fee_fils" >= 0

vehicle_blocks_period_bounded.name: vehicle_blocks_period_bounded
vehicle_blocks_period_bounded.value: NOT isempty("vehicle_blocks"."period") AND NOT lower_inf("vehicle_blocks"."period") AND NOT upper_inf("vehicle_blocks"."period")
